youtube_title: Chesterton, 1933: the first proven airliner bombing, never solved (viewer request)
body: You asked for Chesterton. On October 10, 1933, a United Air Lines Boeing 247, on its way from Newark to Oakland, was flying from Cleveland to Chicago. Around 9 o'clock that night, people on the ground heard an explosion, and witnesses said the burning plane was about 1,000 feet up. It came down in Jackson Township, outside Chesterton, and all seven people aboard were lost. Federal agents led by Melvin Purvis found that a bomb had gone off in the rear of the plane, probably nitroglycerin. It is the first proven case of a bomb destroying a commercial airliner. The case was closed in 1935 and has never been solved. Comment your town for the next La Porte After Dark. #Chesterton #PorterCounty #NWI #Indiana #Unsolved #History #LaPorteAfterDark
